description: The ⋮ menu beside the sidebar's search: how the list is grouped (Folder or Date), and which of Baude's own groups are listed. A group is a named list of chats of Baude's own, whatever host they're on. Opened by clicking the ⋮ button.

parts.name: Group by
parts.shows: A section headed "Group by" with two radio-style items: "Folder" and "Date", the current one marked. Remembered across restarts. Folder is the default.

actions.does: Regroups the list: by folder (open chat's folder first, then by latest activity), or by day (Today, Yesterday, five days, Older).

parts.name: Groups
parts.shows: A section headed "Groups" with: a list of every group (Baude's own groups), alphabetical case-insensitively, then "No group" last; then "New Group…"; then "Show All" (only while something is left out). Groups known: those made with New Group…, those chats are put in, and those hosts' sessions were started in.

parts.name: Group list (filter)
parts.shows: One row per group: a tick on the left (visible while the group is listed), the group's name (cut with … at about 24 characters, dim when marked so), and an optional dim note after it. Everything is listed until some are picked; ticks show what's listed. Which groups are listed is remembered across restarts, and a group that has gone is neither shown nor counted out.

phone.does: A tap toggles one group in or out of the list
phone.why: No Shift/Ctrl or arrow keys on touch

actions.does: Adds that group to those listed, or takes it out; with none left, everything is listed again (all ticked).
Moves among rows without picking; at either end leaves the list to the menu's other items.
Lists only the focused group, as a click does; Ctrl/⌘ + Space adds or takes it out.
Menu: "Rename Group…" and "Delete Group". The "No group" row has none.

parts.name: Group right-click menu
parts.shows: Two items at the pointer: "Rename Group…" and "Delete Group".

actions.does: Opens the group-name dialog headed "Rename group" (GroupName.dialog.json); its chats move to the new name (to a group already there, they join it); the group stays listed if it was.
The group is deleted at once, its chats put in no group; a toast "Group “<name>” deleted" with an Undo button (5 seconds) restores the group, its chats and what was listed.

parts.name: New Group…
parts.shows: A menu item "New Group…" under the list.

actions.does: Opens the group-name dialog "New group" (GroupName.dialog.json); the group is made, listed even if empty, no chat moved.

parts.name: Show All
parts.shows: "Show All", shown only while some group is left out of the list.

parts.name: Group view of the open chat (open_group)
parts.shows: Not a screen: the group of the open chat is its put-in group, else (for a host's session) the group it was started in unless that is only its host's own, else none; a new chat not written in yet has the group it was started in. The open chat that's not saved yet is listed only if its group is listed; a new chat's group (see Sidebar.region.json, New session's group rule) is ticked in the menu too if it wasn't.

states.name: some listed
states.shows: Only those rows ticked; "Show All" present.

states.name: no groups at all
states.shows: Just "No group" in the list, ticked.
